title: Vegan Cranberry Sauce
summary: Every holiday table needs something gorgeously bright, tart, and fresh, and this vegan cranberry sauce checks all the boxes. I use fresh cranberries, orange juice, maple syrup, and a little cinnamon f…
ingredients: 1/4 cup maple syrup (for sweeter taste add an additional 1/4 cup )
steps: In a saucepan combine maple syrup, orange juice, water, and orange zest. Bring to a boil.
Add cranberries and cinnamon. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until cranberries burst and soften.
Remove from heat. Transfer to a bowl, and chill. Cranberry sauce will thicken as it cools.
